text:
alex: Quick question — anyone bringing a CRT for the retro corner tonight? I can lug my 20kg Trinitron but need a hand carrying it down two flights.
tanya: I can help with the carry if you park in the loading bay by 5:45. Also have a SCART->HDMI converter if needed.
joel: I have composite adapters and a Dreamcast with 3 controllers. Also a GameCube (no memory cards tho).
marie: Bringing my Steam Deck and a USB-C hub. Does anyone have an HDMI->USB capture I can borrow for a quick stream?
alex: Would love the hub. I don't have a capture card but I can bring an old Elgato if it helps — battery life on the Deck will be tight without passthrough.
tanya: I actually have a tiny battery pack that can do passthrough, happy to bring it. Also a spare HDMI->USB-C adapter. Marking it on the gear table.
joel: FYI CRT setup might need the power outlet in the lounge moved. Can facilities leave that outlet free? ops-bot, any chance?
ops-bot: Facilities ping sent to @facilities-team. Reminder: heavy items should be signed in at reception per office policy: https://intranet.redwood/receiving.
marie: Also wondering about controllers — I can bring two bluetooth Xbox pads. Anyone with a wired PS2->USB adapter? For some Tekken nostalgia.
alex: I have a PS2->USB adapter tucked away. It works but sometimes you need to reseat it a couple times.
tanya: Side poll: CRT matches or crisp HDMI for the stream? I vote CRT for authenticity, but stream viewers might complain about scanlines. :thinking_face:
joel: CRT for on-site vibe, HDMI for the stream. We can switch between sets.
marie: Can someone drop a mini schedule? I can run a 30min "Intro to Dreamcast GC tunes" segment if people want.
alex: Tentative plan:
```
17:45 - load-in & CRT setup
18:15 - tech test / Deck passthrough check
18:30 - casual matches (GC / Dreamcast)
19:30 - Steam Deck showcase & indie highlights
20:15 - retro tournament bracket starts
21:30 - teardown
```
tanya: Also calling dibs on the Mario Kart couch slot. :raised_hand:
joel: If anyone wants to borrow an SD card for Dreamcast VMU saves, I have a couple.
marie: Tiny reminder — guests welcome but please sign them in. Ops-bot already sent the link but adding here: https://intranet.redwood/visitors.
ops-bot: Helpful note: please label any personal gear with your name. Facilities will not store gear overnight without prior sign-off.
alex: Awesome, see y'all tonight. If you need a hand with the Trinitron, ping me here and I'll coordinate a carry team. :tv:
